fact: GRAIN's study says none of the four countries, Senegal included, has an AI-specific law or mandatory mechanisms for algorithmic transparency, audit or redress for AI discrimination.
Senegal's Commission de protection des donnees personnelles (CDP) condemns AI-generated manipulated content and deep fakes and says their authors are exposed to sanctions provided by law.
